en: A black‑and‑white vintage view of a rustic wooden farmhouse or chalet surrounded by trees. The building has a balcony with carved railing, a steep roof with overhangs, and small shuttered windows. A simple wooden fence lines a dirt path in the foreground, where several people, including a child, are standing or walking. The scene has an old rural, park‑like atmosphere. Red printed text appears along the bottom edge.
